items.title: JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley Fight Suits Over Role in Buyout Deals
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Morgan Stanley are among banks shareholders are suing over their roles on multibillion-dollar buyout deals after a recent corporate-law overhaul failed to protect financial advisers from potential liability.

items.title: JPMorgan’s Berro Says Bond Market Can Handle High-Grade Stampede
items.summary: The investment-grade bond market faces a busy September, but demand for corporate debt suggests anxiety about heavy supply may be overblown, according to Kelsey Berro, a portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management.

items.title: Morgan Stanley’s Bobby Singh: Why We Are Exploring an International Wealth Push
items.summary: The largest offshore wealth provider in the U.S. would like to serve clients on their own turf. Bobby Singh is leading the effort.

items.title: JP Morgan Warns of Fall Sell-Off Potential: 5 Defensive Dividend Stocks to Buy
items.summary: J.P. Morgan's technical team sees deteriorating market internals and a pattern eerily similar to the months before the 1999 tech crash. Five dividend-paying stocks across defensive sectors may offer shelter if the autumn sell-off materializes.

items.title: JPMorgan's Card Credit Trends Improve: Are Losses Past Their Peak?
items.summary: JPM's improving card credit trends and lower 2026 loss outlook signal stabilization, though elevated rates remain a risk to further progress.

items.title: JPMorgan stays constructive on stocks, expects a grind higher with rotation
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan told clients in a note on Monday that it remains positive on equities heading into the year-end, but expects gains to come through rotation rather than a broad melt-up.

items.title: Walmart stock price target reset by JPMorgan after earnings
items.summary: JPMorgan adjusted its Walmart stock price target after the retailers quarterly update.

items.title: If a Bear Market Is Coming, Here's What All of the Smartest Investors Are Doing Right Now
items.summary: There is a bear market waiting to pounce at some point in the future, so you'll want to act now to make sure you avoid panicking.
